intro: Huntsman Markhor in Revantusk Village has lost his twin brother Malkhor, taken by the Vilebranch in the same raid that took Torntusk's mate. Malkhor met a swift, brutal end, and his remains were fed to the Vilebranch's oozes and wolves. Markhor says his brother's life is beyond saving, yet his soul can still be rescued, and he asks you to recover the remains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.
Sadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.
It is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: When I have his remains, I shall take them to Yayo'jin and have them prepared for a proper burial.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My dearest brother, how I will miss you...
Thank you for your assistance, friend. You are truly a hero in my eyes.
